explanation: One of the patriarchs in the Bible, son of Isaac and Rebekah, brother to Esau.
A place in Canaan where Jacob had a dream about a ladder reaching up to heaven; means "house of God".
An experience during sleep where one sees images and events that may have symbolic meaning.
In Jacob's dream the ladder symbolizes the connection between heaven and earth and God's presence.
Spiritual beings who serve God and carry out his will; in the dream angels go up and down the ladder.
A title for God that emphasizes his sovereignty and authority.
An obligation or guarantee given by God to fulfill certain conditions or blessings.
The area that God promised to give to Jacob's descendants, later known as the land of Israel.
Offspring or relatives who come from a specific person, in this case Jacob.
A special favor or gift from God, often linked with happiness, prosperity and protection.
